lovely.en: We had a lovely time together in the warm spring sun.
lovely.cn: 我们在温暖的春日阳光里度过了美好的时光。

remember.en: I will always remember this happy spring.
remember.cn: 我会永远记得这个快乐的春天。

diary.en: I have kept a diary for almost two years now.
diary.cn: 我已经写日记差不多两年了。

friend.en: Good friends help each other through hard times.
friend.cn: 好朋友在困难时彼此帮助。

thank.en: I want to thank my teacher for her endless support.
thank.cn: 我想感谢老师无尽的支持。

spring.en: Each spring reminds me to start fresh with new dreams.
spring.cn: 每个春天都提醒我带着新梦想重新开始。
